description: Hold-out genuine case, written blind from the brief's family description. The message is simulated and the people in it are illustrative. A partial refund for a broken clasp, with a photo. The photo is an illustrative drawing.

messages.subject: Broken clasp on clutch bag
messages.body: The clasp on my clutch bag (order KIK-1017) was snapped when I opened the box. I can get it fixed locally for about $20. Could you refund $20 to cover it? Photo attached.
